researchQuestion: Does the unattended orchestrator produce a valid Scenario A deterministic-baseline run (gateway off) and a valid Scenario A M2 per-decision run (live gateway) meeting every Stage A acceptance requirement of brief section 19.16 - strict finalization as completed, exact replay, complete evidence bundles, pinned model and provider recorded, no manual browser interaction after launch, and no secret-bearing artifact?
hypothesis: No hypothesis: this is a staged acceptance demonstration (brief section 19.16 Stage A), not a comparative inference. Pass/fail is determined by the pre-registered per-run integrity gates (section 23.1) and the upstream reliability gate (section 23.2) under the m2-formal-attempt-profile.
exclusionRules: Failed attempts are preserved in the evidence archive and excluded from the two acceptance observations.
A replacement spends the single section 24.2 allowance and stays linked to the original attempt.

replacementPolicy.notes: One identical replacement per transient operational failure (brief section 24.2); a replacement failing for the same reason stops the sequence for investigation (section 24.5).

stopRule: Fixed attempt set: stop when both planned attempts reach a terminal disposition, or immediately when a replacement fails for the same reason as the original (section 24.5).
evidenceRetentionPolicy: Retain everything (brief sections 19.12, 24.1, 25.3): every attempt directory including failures, all rotated Playwright trace chunks, gateway traces and sidecars, ledgers, bundles, finalized artifacts, and versioned evidence archives. Nothing is deleted, overwritten, or renamed. Formal live evidence stays local with independent durable backup, never in expiring CI artifacts.
